Maa chhota teaspoon me ghana sirup uthakar roti hui bachchi ke munh mein daalti hai.
Bachchi ruk jaati hai, gulle khulla hua, aankh thi dhori thi—aur phir wapas nahi jagi.
Winslow's Soothing Syrup, jiska ads tha kehte kal ka dard door karna.
Iske raaz the morphine aur alcohol: ek teaspoon thi roughly 20 laudanum ke boond jaisi morphine, jo tab shishon ko di jaati thi do teen boondon se.
Bachchi sedated thi, breathing slow ho gayi thi.
1868 tak company bti 1.5 million bottles saal bhar.
Labels kuch nahi batate the, to parents teething, colic, ya diarrhea ko karan maante the jab shishu marte the.
Hazaaron maante ke mare gaye the.
1906 mein Pure Food and Drug Act aya, jisne manufacturers se kaha ki opiates ka khulasa dein.
Medicine badli, par bottles dukan par reh gayi.
Soothing syrup ban gayi thi silent killer.
